name: Ambivalent Instruments
author: TsugumasaYutani
description: Ambivalent Instruments (abbreviated as "ambv inst.") is an independent modular synthesizer developer based in Japan.

modules.name: Grainer
modules.description: Real-time granular synthesis processor with advanced randomization

modules.name: EQ8
modules.description: 8-band stereo parametric equalizer with fixed frequency bands

modules.name: Feedback EQ8
modules.description: Stereo 8-band parametric equalizer (fixed peaking and shelf bands) with one global feedback control (±95%) for resonance and self-osc. In-loop limiter and DC block stabilize the loop; output is the dry EQ signal.

modules.name: XFMN01
modules.description: Cross-FM noise synthesizer with several effects

modules.name: Delay
modules.description: Digital delay effect with 4 modes (Repitch/Octave/Reverse/Ping-pong), feedback, and modulation

modules.name: Delay Expander
modules.description: Tap tempo and sync expander for Ambivalent Instruments Delay modules

modules.name: GroupDelay
modules.description: Group delay effect using cascaded all-pass filters for transient shaping and phase dispersion

modules.name: Cheby
modules.description: Chebyshev harmonic generator with H1-H8 sliders

modules.name: AutoPanTremolo
modules.description: Stereo auto-pan and tremolo effect with adjustable LFO curve and sync

modules.name: NØ!SE//ERR
modules.description: A dual-output noise oscillator that travels seamlessly between calm and agitation, harmony and dissonance.
